subject.title: Multi-agent orchestration is unstable: concurrent agents add/config overwrites, session-lock failures, and detached child work

question: Should #43367 remain the canonical umbrella while focused session-lock, completion-delivery, fallback-lane, and config-write fixes land, or should maintainers replace it with a narrower durable multi-agent completion design item?
rationale: The remaining failures are real, but the permanent fix crosses session write ownership, subagent completion durability, fallback-lane cancellation, detached-work cleanup, and compatibility semantics that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue open, review #86540 and other narrow fixes independently, and close the umbrella only when all linked root-cause slices are resolved or explicitly split.

options.title: Promote Durable Completion Design
options.body: Make a dedicated durable completion/outbox and metadata-only handoff design the canonical item, then map every remaining production-evidence thread to that contract.

options.title: Split By Root Cause
options.body: Close this umbrella only after maintainers assign each remaining symptom to a narrower canonical issue with an owner and validation path.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella And Land Focused Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open, review #86540 and other narrow fixes independently, and close the umbrella only when all linked root-cause slices are resolved or explicitly split.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is product architecture across core agent/session/fallback behavior, and history points to steipete as the broadest area owner among sampled files.
